cases.case_label: Recurrent Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4 (c.4052_4053ins328) in Korean cohort
cases.disease: Autosomal recessive RP1-associated retinal dystrophy (RP, macular, cone and cone-rod dystrophy)
cases.mechanism_detail: The recurrent Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4 causes a frameshift (p.Tyr1352Alafs*9); detected by IGV soft-clip review, Alu-PCR and long-read WGS in 14% of 143 Korean RP1 patients (about 20), in trans with other truncating alleles in AR RP, macular or cone(-rod) dystrophy.
cases.quote: The Alu insertion c.4052_4053ins328 (p.Tyr1352Alafs*9) was carried by 14% of patients.
